description: This file defines the StreamWrapperInterface interface for Drupal, extending PHP stream wrapper functionality with constants and method signatures for managing stream wrappers within Drupal.

classes.name: StreamWrapperInterface
classes.description: An interface extending PhpStreamWrapperInterface, defining constants and methods for Drupal stream wrappers.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of stream wrapper as one of the defined constants.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the stream wrapper for UI purposes.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the stream wrapper for UI purposes.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the absolute URI for the stream resource.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the current URI of the stream resource.

methods.name: getExternalUrl
methods.description: Provides a web-accessible URL for the resource.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the resource, default implementation may be overridden.

methods.name: dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory name from a given URI.
